run_relax_job: run a geometry optimization job on an atomic structure using an ASE calculator and optimization flags
run_single_point_job: run a single-point energy and force calculation on an atomic structure using an ASE calculator
run_conformers: run conformer energy and geometry calculations by optimizing molecular conformers across molecule families
run_protonation: run protonation state energy and geometry calculations for molecules across different protonation states
run_ieea: run unoptimized ionization energy and electron affinity calculations on structures at different charge and spin states
